title: Citrus Spruce Reset

diffuser.notes: Run 30–45 min while airing the room; refresh after vacuuming.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each mist; spot-test fabrics first.

why_it_works: Grapefruit lifts with a fresh citrus peel tone, while black spruce and tea tree add a cool, clean forest-air impression—well suited to a just-tidied autumn home.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
